evidence_quotes.quote: GMKtec NucBox G3 Plus powered by Intel Twin Lake Processor N150 (4 Cores / 4 Threads, up to 3.6 GHz, 6 MB cache, 6W TDP, Intel Graphics 24 EU up to 1000 MHz), single DDR4-3200 SO-DIMM slot, 2.5GbE RJ-45 LAN.
Compact chassis dimensions 114 x 106 x 42.5 mm, net unit weight 361 g, DC 12V / 3A (36W) 100-240V AC power adapter, dual HDMI 2.0 4K@60Hz, 4x USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-A, M.2 2280 NVMe + M.2 2242 SATA.
Official GMKtec NucBox G3 Plus platform firmware, BIOS, Windows 11 Pro drivers, and compliance documentation portal supporting Intel N150 Twin Lake series.

adversarial_checks: Power & PSU envelope check: Verified wall power hierarchy 6.5 W idle <= 15 W typical <= 25 W sustained multi-core stress, staying comfortably under the 36 W (12V/3A) adapter ceiling, with 26 <= 34 dBA acoustics.
Storage & I/O trap audit: Flagged that the second M.2 2242 slot is strictly SATA-only (incompatible with NVMe SSDs), memory is single-channel DDR4 only, and there are zero USB-C ports on the chassis.

SM-02 & Korea customs threshold check: Distinguished barebones (<$150 duty-free threshold) from the benchmarked 16GB/512GB Win11 Pro SKU ($199.99 USD / 289,000 KRW) under msrp_benchmark_mode with asin: null.
